name: attack-surface-mcp-server
description: Passive external attack-surface mapping: CT subdomains, DNS, TLS, HTTP posture, RDAP/WHOIS, Shodan via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

SHODAN_API_KEY.title: Shodan API key
SHODAN_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables attacksurface_lookup_host (host intelligence). The rest of the server works without it.

CERTSPOTTER_API_KEY.title: Certspotter API key
CERTSPOTTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Raises Certspotter rate limits for the CT-log subdomain fallback.
